title: Chakravala method solves 'Pell's equation'
summary: Building on Brahmagupta and Jayadeva, Bhaskara II gave the chakravala method, a general way to solve the equation x^2 - n y^2 = 1.
why: A landmark of number theory, solved in India centuries before Europe.

unsung.contribution: Gave a general method (chakravala) for solving the equation later called Pell's equation.
unsung.recognition: The equation is named after John Pell because Euler mistakenly attributed Brouncker's solution to him.
